text: City Council on November 12 and 13, 2025, referred Item AU10.9 to the December 4, 2025 meeting of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee for consideration.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the June 10, 2026 meeting of Infrastructure and Environment Committee, and requested the General Manager, Transportation Services, to establish a standard and a timeline for accumulated road cuts to be completely repaired.
